integrity: The full proof and numerical verification script are included; numerical checks do not prove infinite-dimensional or asymptotic statements. An accessible thesis is dated 2023 but its first public repository-deposit day has not been verified, so the exact 2024-02-20 arXiv submission serves as verified first-public date.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an increasing-intensity Poisson-null result for the fitted-Poisson-weight L1 statistic only. It makes no assertion about parametric-bootstrap size, rejection power, or the other eight test statistics. General occupancy theory may be related; priority is not independently certified.
title: A square-root sample-size transition and an infinite cusp ladder for a fitted-Poisson empirical weight test
